neighbours.label: 'preschool' (pre-school, preescolar, preschoolers): education before school age
fire: Our daughter starts preschool in September and is very excited.
The city plans to offer free pre-school places to every family.
Many preschoolers learn to count by singing simple songs.
Funding for preschool programs rose sharply in the new budget.
She has worked as a preschool teacher for twelve years.
Research shows that early childhood education pays off later in life.
Parents toured three preschools before choosing one near home.
The center runs a pre-school reading club on Tuesday mornings.
quiet: Our daughter starts high school in September and is very excited.
The city plans to offer free college places to every family.
Many teenagers learn to count cards by playing simple games.
Funding for university programs rose sharply in the new budget.
She has worked as a chemistry teacher for twelve years.
Research shows that adult education pays off later in life.
Parents toured three colleges before choosing one near home.
The center runs an after-work reading club on Tuesday evenings.

notes: Card only: top examples ' preschool' x11, 'chool' x9, '-school' x5, ' childhood' x5. Near misses use school / high school / kindergarten-free school words.
